The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Smada]] lived in a '''stronghold''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]]. His fortress was located on the far side of the planet's only [[D'vouran spaceport|village]] just inside the forest. It consisted of two towers that rose above the trees. While it appeared to be a mansion to Humans, it was considered more of a summer cabin than a fortress by Hutt standards. Smada had the fortress constructed to "take a short vacation" from the gang wars on his home planet. There, he was served by several [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] minions. Smada's stronghold was destroyed after the planet devoured itself.
